text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower has finished the Nikkei<n>Sho. Zenno Rob
Roy, who was<n>cheering Rice Shower on from the
stands, visits her afterward.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She says Rice Shower is like a hero<n>from a book,
always moving forward<n>toward her goals.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower, though embarrassed, is<n>delighted to
hear she's come closer<n>to becoming a blue rose.
